Rumors about the next-generation Apple TV 4K have been circulating for a while, and everyone expects it to come with a more modern chip to support Apple Intelligence. But according to the latest leak discovered by Aaron Perris, the actual chip will be even more powerful than previously expected.

Code leaks reveal that the upcoming Apple TV 4K will feature an A19 or A19 Pro chip

We've been waiting for the new Apple TV 4K for a long time — longer than at any point in this product's history.

There were originally rumors that the new model would launch in 2025, with evidence at the time suggesting it would use the A17 Pro chip. The A17 Pro is currently the lowest-tier chip that supports Apple Intelligence, so it seemed very reasonable back then, and would also represent a significant upgrade over the current A15 Bionic.

But according to Aaron Perris, the chip in the next-generation Apple TV 4K appears to be even more powerful than expected. He said:

We've discovered code related to Apple's upcoming Apple TV model, the AppleTV18,1

From razmsu's top-voted comment

I just want it to make a sound when I'm looking for the remote. That's all. Please.

The "18,1" numbering convention is similar to the identifiers Apple used for last year's iPhone 17 lineup. Some iPhone 17 models use the A19 chip, while the iPhone Air and 17 Pro models use the A19 Pro.

Either chip would be quite a significant upgrade for the Apple TV. But I suspect the A19 Pro might be more likely, because only it can support the most advanced Siri AI features.

Siri AI is expected to be one of the headline features of the next-generation Apple TV 4K. Considering how long it's been since the last hardware refresh, I'm hoping Apple won't launch the new device missing some of its AI capabilities.

Are you planning to buy the next-generation Apple TV 4K? Let us know in the comments.
